nonclaims: No production codec, hash, ID formula, ABI, limit, storage layout, contract topology, Realm, or deployment is selected.
No trace proves chain canonicality, finality, offchain byte permanence, target-chain support, or hyperstructure status.
Named states are ordering anchors only; required stateDelta objects and qualified result envelopes are authoritative.
Symbolic paths and values must become exact disposable candidate bytes and digests before an implementation claims agreement.

candidateSemantics.nonceRule: one nonce may name only one exact AdmissionPlan; exact retry recovers that operation
candidateSemantics.verifierSelectionRule: use only the exact verifier profile bound by the signed plan; never dispatch by hasCode
candidateSemantics.withdrawalRule: append issuer-qualified lifecycle evidence; never delete a Record or rewind a Binding
candidateSemantics.queryCompletionRule: only a Realm transition may derive terminal completion from the exact interval, high-water, count/root, and postings commitment
candidateSemantics.externalDependencyRule: an external code, verifier, or dependency observation never mutates Realm state; profile-dependent current recognition requires the exact declared basis, while retained historical receipts keep their original basis
candidateSemantics.resultKindRule: coverage qualifies an exact point or declared finite scope only; mutation and submission outcomes use coverage=NOT_APPLICABLE
candidateSemantics.projectionRule: every trace is projected through LOSSLESS_ALL_LAYERS; a convenience label may never replace the qualified envelope

LOSSLESS_ALL_LAYERS.rule: friendly labels may simplify display but may not omit or rewrite any retained field

assertions: Realm identity commits origin/genesis and Core bootstrap rather than bare chainId.
Revision zero and every possible power are state-readable.
Bootstrap success does not claim authored admission or hyperstructure status.
RA and RB derive distinct RealmIds, cache keys, receipt domains, and replay domains.
Deriving or inspecting RB does not add it to RA state.
RC cannot alias RA even when chainId, addresses, and visible code match.
The left branch is internally complete at its own exact observer basis.
Completeness does not claim finality or global canonicality.
The right branch is internally complete at its own exact observer basis.
Completeness does not claim finality or global canonicality.
Both attributed branch answers and their bases are retained.
The aggregate reports CONFLICT; it does not silently choose current or final.
An omitted mutation path fails bootstrap authentication.
Disclosed mutability never implies hyperstructure status.
No new profile-dependent admission or effect is recognized without a declared RealmRevision and exact basis.
The historical V1 receipt remains readable under its retained basis.
A Realm with this undisclosed effective mutation cannot claim the candidate hyperstructure conditions.
REC_B extracts exactly one closed reference to REC_A.
Author, Realm, and QueryProfile do not change Record identity.
The first deterministic structural error rejects without adding a twin artifact or changing any Realm state.
Author, actor, relayer, payer, destination, nonce, expiry, effects, verifier profile, and expected revision remain distinct.
Both leaves, postings, receipts, Binding revision one, and one scope row commit together.
executionCoordinate=expiryCoordinate-1 is valid.
Relayer or payer identity cannot substitute for the semantic author's declared verifier result.
No first leaf, posting, receipt, nonce consumption, scope row, or Binding effect survives.
Portable publication authorship is not destination admission or effect authority.
Destination Realm is an individually falsifiable signed replay coordinate.
Realm revision is an individually falsifiable signed replay coordinate.
Core commitment is an individually falsifiable signed replay coordinate.
Actor is an individually falsifiable signed authority coordinate.
The exact ordered effect set is an individually falsifiable signed coordinate.
A tampered precondition fails authority before execution; B1 separately tests an authorized but stale CAS.
One scoped nonce names only one exact AdmissionPlan; a different plan is conflict, not retry.
The boundary is exclusive: executionCoordinate=expiryCoordinate is invalid.
executionCoordinate>expiryCoordinate is invalid and cannot consume the nonce.
The exact operation identity and receipt are recovered.
No duplicate posting, receipt, nonce, scope row, admission ordinal, high-water increment, or Binding revision is created.
Verifier selection follows the declared signed profile, never hasCode.
Contract-like returndata cannot create ambient ERC-1271 fallback.
The declared EOA profile rejects; code-provided ERC-1271 magic is irrelevant and creates no fallback.
Changing the declared verifier profile or omitting its exact basis cannot reuse an EOA witness.
The receipt retains digest, domain, account, signature, profile, code/dependency basis, bounded call policy/result, and execution coordinate.
External code changes no EFS Realm state.
Current V2 rejection of S1 is a separate observation, not a rewrite of V1 history.
Current Vault code is never recalled to reinterpret the historical admission.
Current recognition cannot manufacture a past admission or occurrence.
History appends and the scope contains POSITION_K exactly once.
No otherwise valid admission, nonce, receipt, posting, history, scope, or Binding side effect survives a stale precondition.
Prior values remain historical and cannot become current by fallback.
A Binding tombstone is not a Withdrawal.
Withdrawal deletes no Record, rewinds no Binding, withdraws no other issuer's Occurrence, and resurrects no prior head.
QueryProfile identity grants no activation authority.
QAP_RA_REV0 authorizes COUNCIL, not MALLORY.
Fanout limit is independently falsifiable.
Maximum activation/backfill cost is independently falsifiable.
Activation authority is not authority to charge an unconsenting payer.
The exact sponsor consent and future-writer cost rule are part of the activation policy basis.
Activation records exact authority, cost, consent, generation, interval, and basis.
New covered writes dual-write only under the separately pinned future-writer rule.
A nonempty partial page proves neither complete scope nor absence.
An empty partial page is UNKNOWN/PARTIAL, never absence.
The separately adopted future-writer rule authorizes exactly one generation-one posting and its bounded cost.
The activation remains PARTIAL; one dual-write does not complete historical backfill.
Neither activation authority nor writer authority permits charging PAYER without pinned policy authority or consent.
Neither profile author, activator, operator, nor indexer can self-assert COMPLETE.
Complete applies only to the exact Type, generation, finite interval, high-water, ordering, and Realm/observer basis.
A known coordinate mismatch is a deterministic invalid request, not missing data.
Unavailable basis remains UNKNOWN/PARTIAL; it is not an invalid cursor or an empty scope.
A complete exact point proof establishes no enumeration completeness.
Only authoritative complete local absence at the higher priority permits the pinned fallback.
UNKNOWN or PARTIAL never becomes absence and never silently falls through.
Wrong planId, purpose, scope, Realm, position, combiner, or cap cannot reuse the risk-bearer's consent.
Unsupported policy is explicit and never becomes absence or fallback.
A supported profile with unavailable basis is UNKNOWN/PARTIAL, not UNSUPPORTED or absent.
Integrity failure does not erase the Record or prove absence.
Unavailability does not erase the Record or imply corrupt bytes.
Verified partial bytes are neither complete bytes nor unavailable bytes.

unresolved: OP_X1 absent with full Realm projection equal to pre-state
OP_X1 committed with its exact atomic declared effect set
no partially committed effect set is legal

assertions: Only canonical state read-back may upgrade UNKNOWN to COMMITTED or NOT_COMMITTED_PROVEN.
An independent reader enumerates the declared finite projection and reproduces its exact disposable digest.
Unrelated chain state outside the declared projection is ignored.
Missing input remains qualified incomplete; it cannot manufacture a smaller complete Realm.
A deterministically detected mismatch is INVALID with projection integrity failure, not mere incompleteness.

illegalCombinations: kind=MUTATION or kind=SUBMISSION with coverage other than NOT_APPLICABLE
kind=SCOPE with an empty page and presence=ABSENT_PROVEN unless coverage=COMPLETE over the exact declared finite domain and basis
effect=UNKNOWN with coverage other than NOT_APPLICABLE
coverage=COMPLETE from a short page, timeout, point proof applied to a scope, event scan, indexer claim, or unavailable basis
validation=SEMANTICALLY_VALID solely because a Realm admitted the Occurrence
authority=AUTHORIZED from signature shape, hasCode, current ERC1271 code, self-declared interface, or unpinned policy
selection=CURRENT without a bounded Binding or Lens evaluation at the stated basis
effect=COMMITTED from wallet, bundler, RPC, transaction, or relayer acknowledgement without canonical effect read-back
bytes=PARTIAL, UNAVAILABLE, or INTEGRITY_FAILED implying presence=ABSENT_PROVEN
projectionIntegrity=MISSING_REQUIRED_ITEM or INTEGRITY_FAILED represented as MATCHED
presence=MASKED represented as absence without retaining mask policy and basis
notCoveredByMinimum: OPAQUE and MASKED product projections beyond their no-collapse rules
wide conflict-combiner matrices beyond one pinned Lens conflict rule
X1 canonical committed and not-committed follow-up read-backs after the submission-uncertainty control
full verifier gas, returndata, reentrancy, delegation lifecycle, signature-suite and malleability corpus
all final topology arms, application workloads, and scale ceilings
minimumComparators: flat exact Type versus one bundled and one layered/View trace over identical accepted values
full-width Principal versus one tagged author trace
portable shared PublicationSet versus one self-contained and one Realm-bound trace
self-authenticating Realm bootstrap versus bare chainId and visible-root-only controls
freezeOnlyExpansion: ceremony-final independent cross-language codecs, IDs, rejection precedence, and hard caps
full signature malleability, ERC1271 gas, return-data, reentrancy, recursive dependency, and second-suite corpus
all supported proxy, beacon, facet, library, registry, pause, and emergency-power shapes
million-record QueryProfile pressure, dead postings, hostile hot values, and final cost allocation
complete cold and warm Lens gas matrix and all final caps
two independent reconstructors, authenticated proof inputs, reorg replay, and clean-room toolchain regeneration
final physical topology, production manifest, target Realm, Commons, and hyperstructure claim

stateDeltaSchema.authority: expectedPostState is a human ordering alias; stateDelta is the machine-facing semantic contract
stateDeltaSchema.exactRule: EXACT requires all four lists. The complete authoritative projection is unchanged except for paths named by mustAdd, mustChange, or mustAdvance; mustNotChange may add stronger local assertions. Every authoritative state change recomputes finiteInventoryCount and projectionRoot.
stateDeltaSchema.unobservedRule: UNOBSERVED is legal only for a dropped submission channel. It asserts neither change nor equality and must name the unresolved atomic alternatives.
stateDeltaSchema.pathGrammar: symbolic collection[key]=value, collection[key]:from->to, or counter:from->to; exact disposable paths and digests replace these expressions in the byte seal
stateDeltaSchema.rejectionRule: every effectful rejection has empty mustAdd, mustChange, and mustAdvance plus mustNotChange=[RealmState:*], including nonces, receipts, postings, scopes, counters, and projection root

namedStates.S_EMPTY: No Realm bootstrap, revision, Type, Record, Publication, Occurrence, operation, admission, Binding, Withdrawal, QueryProfile activation, posting, or counter entry.
namedStates.S_RA0: R0 applied to S_EMPTY: RA bootstrap and revision zero exist; all data-plane collections are empty and every data-plane counter is zero.
namedStates.S_RA_SHARED_PREFORK: One authenticated RA state before two observer branches; neither descendant is assumed canonical or final.
namedStates.PORTABLE_EMPTY: No portable candidate artifacts in the disposable artifact store; no Realm state is implied.
namedStates.S_RA0_VAULT_V1_ACCEPTS: S_RA0 plus the exact externally observed VAULT_V1 verifier dependency basis pinned by RA revision zero.
namedStates.S_VAULT_CD_ADMITTED_V1_EXTERNAL_V2: Same authoritative Realm state as S_VAULT_CD_ADMITTED_V1 plus a later external VAULT_V2 observation.
namedStates.S_ADMITTED_ALICE_AB: S_ADMITTED_ALICE_AB_BIND_K_REV1 viewed at the QueryProfile seam.
namedStates.S_QP_TOPIC_ACTIVE_PARTIAL: Q1A applied to S_ADMITTED_ALICE_AB with activation generation one and a nonterminal coverage high-water.
namedStates.S_QP_TOPIC_ALL_INTERVALS_PROCESSED: S_QP_TOPIC_ACTIVE_PARTIAL after all declared postings exist, before terminal count/root acceptance.
namedStates.S_COUNCIL_ABSENT_ALICE_BIND_REC_A: Pinned Lens basis where Council position K is authoritatively absent and Alice position K is REC_A.
namedStates.S_COUNCIL_UNKNOWN_ALICE_BIND_REC_A: Pinned Lens request where Alice is known but the required Council basis is unavailable.
namedStates.S_TREASURY_PINS_SAFE_PLAN: TREASURY has pinned PLAN_COUNCIL_THEN_ALICE for the exact purpose, scope, Realm, position, and cap.
namedStates.S_SAFE_PLAN_WITH_UNSUPPORTED_REQUIRED_PR: The pinned Plan names a profile this candidate Realm does not support.
namedStates.S_RECORD_AND_ADMISSION_PRESENT: The exact Record and its admission are present at a pinned basis; byte retrieval is evaluated separately.
namedStates.S_BEFORE_UNOBSERVED_OPERATION: Exact Realm state before OP_X1 submission, with no observation of its canonical outcome.
namedStates.S_FULL_MICRO_REALM: One compatible reference branch: R0 then P0, B0, B2, B3, Q1A, Q1D, and the Q3 completion law over that branch's exact interval, plus PLAN_COUNCIL_THEN_ALICE. Alternative Carol and Vault verifier controls are excluded rather than merged across conflicting admission ordinals.
namedStates.S_QP_TOPIC_ACTIVE_PARTIAL_PLUS_FUTURE_WR: Q1D applied to S_QP_TOPIC_ACTIVE_PARTIAL; the activation remains partial while the new admitted write is present in both base and generation-one query postings.

factsMatrix.portableValidity: Type/Record structural and semantic result under exact portable interpreter
factsMatrix.realmAdmission: destination occurrence, policy, verifier, lifecycle and operation basis
factsMatrix.pointKnowledge: exact key presence at one exact Realm/observer basis
factsMatrix.scopeCoverage: declared finite domain, generation, cursor, high-water, ordering and completion commitment
factsMatrix.byteAvailability: separate from Record presence and admission
factsMatrix.authority: exact principal, plan, verifier profile and historical/current basis
factsMatrix.selection: Binding or risk-bearer-approved finite Lens result
factsMatrix.effect: canonical operation read-back, never transport acknowledgement
factsMatrix.finality: retained observer evidence; intentionally not collapsed into any result axis
